meta.title: Three Shops, One Bracket
meta.author: Joe Guadagnino / Lupton Associates
meta.painPoint: multi-vendor finger-pointing: a bracket cut, formed, and coated at three shops on three POs, and nobody owns the fit

shots.visual: black; 'Three POs. One bracket.' types in
shots.vo: One bracket. Three shops. Three purchase orders.

shots.visual: fiber laser tracing the bracket outline, sparks; stamp PO #1 · CUT
press brake folding the blank into an L; stamp PO #2 · FORMED
spray booth (brand-kit s4); stamp PO #3 · COATED
gloved hand holds the bracket to a frame, holes don't line up, red vignette pulse
shots.vo: And when the holes don't line up, everyone points at everyone.

shots.visual: one continuous take: laser -> press brake -> weld cell -> powder line into oven; LUPTON ASSOCIATES watermark; UNDER ONE ROOF eyebrow; LASER/FORM/WELD/POWDER chips light on the spoken words
shots.vo: We work with shops that cut, form, weld, and finish under one roof. One print. One project manager. One shop that owns the fit.

shots.visual: badge, LUPTON ASSOCIATES, 'Send us the print.' (sage), 'Let's build it together.', Luptons.com
shots.vo: Send us the print. Let's build it together. Luptons dot com.

captions.text: One bracket. Three shops. Three purchase orders.
And when the holes don't line up, everyone points at everyone.
We work with shops that cut, form, weld, and finish under one roof.
One shop that owns the fit.
